title: 第5章 编外与军校生第6章 索贿
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
“公允教会可能拒绝任何人，但绝不会拒绝一个崭新加入的职业者。”
守在门前，穿着儒生长衫的教士没有学生和老师那样震惊的反应，而是温和地说。
他只是对张绝的年轻有些略微惊讶。
散星法师在诸多职业中属于极难入门的那一类，绝大多数人都需要长达十年的预科学习，才能有转职的希望，而开始预科学习的黄金年龄一般是在12岁左右，家庭条件一般的学生甚至还要更晚一些。
所以，绝大部分有天赋的学生真正成为散星法师的时间，一般都在23岁以上。
而张绝从外表上来看，年龄也就是在20岁左右，如果他真的已经成功转职，这就算从历史上来讲，都算是绝对罕见的天才了！
说着同时，那名教士也向张绝伸出了自己的一只手。
“陈鹤，你可以叫我陈教士，方便让我做个验证吗？”
张绝坦然地也将自己的手伸了过去，和陈鹤的手握在一起。
当两人的手接触的那一刻，他便清晰地感觉到有一股柔和、温顺且没有半点侵略性的力量照亮了自己的身体，也照亮了他在成功转职后藏匿于身体之中的散星法师魔力！
“张绝，字绍先。”张绝没有抵触，只是报上了自己的名讳。
而当亲自确定了张绝没有说谎，他确实是在这个年纪成功转职成了散星法师后，名叫陈鹤的教士看向他的目光变得更加友善起来。
“很高兴能亲自接待你这样有天赋的年轻人，张绍先。跟我进来吧，我带你去进行散星法师的职业登记。”
说罢，他便松开张绝的手，在前面领路走向了不远处虚掩着的小门。
张绝也没有什么多余的停留，他对着那已经变得鸦雀无声的老师和学生最后礼貌地点了一下头，随后便跟上了陈鹤的脚步，走进了教会内。
当安静到极点的众人注视着他的背影彻底消失在门后之后，教堂前的这片空地才重新炸开了锅！
刚刚发生在他们眼前的一幕，堪比今天的第三道惊雷。
“怎么可能是张绝！”
“学校不是对他进行过很多次测试，确定他根本没有天赋吗？”
“他才不到二十岁，和他同届的学生中到现在为止还没有一个人转职，现在他转职成功了，不就意味着，意味着他是......”

“他是整个江南省同年第一人！”
“不！他无论如何都当不了江南省同年第一人，第一人是于中甫！”
“但于中甫直到今天死前也都还没转职......”
“于中甫距离转职只差最后临门一脚了！如果不是安焕然干出这种天怒人怨的事情，谁能撼动他的地位？”
“就算是现在也不行！于中甫是为国就义，他张绝就算现在转职又怎样，我还是看不起他！”
“专门选在这一天来公允教会转职登记，他居心叵测！”
“你管人家选哪一天来登记？他就是成为职业者了，你还只是个穷学生！”
“他这样的人成为职业者难说是想要为谁效力，说不定从公允教会出来，转头就变成安焕然的走狗呢！”
纷纷扰扰，各种各样的声音在黑伞下响起。
在这一天，江宁城的学生们已经遭遇了太多足以让他们终身难忘的事情。
而现在正在发生的事，就算与他们这一天经历过的其他那些堪称晴天霹雳的事相比，也毫不逊色。
content_en:
"The Just Church may reject anyone, but it will never reject a new professional."
The priest who was guarding the door and wearing a Confucian gown did not have the shocked reaction of the students and teachers, but spoke gently.
He was only slightly surprised by Zhang Jue's youth.
Among many professions, Sanxing Mage is one of the most difficult to get started with. Most people need ten years of preparatory studies before they can hope to change careers. The golden age for starting preparatory studies is generally around 12 years old, and even later for students with average family conditions.
Therefore, most talented students usually become Sanxing Masters when they are over 23 years old.
Judging from Zhang Jue's appearance, he is around 20 years old. If he has really successfully changed jobs, he will be considered an absolutely rare genius even from a historical perspective!
At the same time, the priest also extended his hand to Zhang Jue.
"Chen He, can you call me Pastor Chen so that I can do a verification?"
Zhang Jue calmly stretched out his hand and held it with Chen He's.
The moment the two people's hands came into contact, he clearly felt a soft, gentle and non-aggressive force lighting up his body, as well as the scattered star mage magic power hidden in his body after his successful job transfer!
"Zhang Jue, courtesy name Shaoxian." Zhang Jue did not resist, but only gave his name.
And after personally confirming that Zhang Jue was not lying and that he had indeed successfully transferred to the Sanxing Mage at this age, the priest named Chen He looked at him and became more friendly.
"It's a pleasure to receive a talented young man like you in person, Zhang Shaoxian. Come in with me, and I'll take you to register for the profession of Master Sanxing."
After saying that, he let go of Zhang Jue's hand and led the way to the small door that was ajar not far away.
Zhang Jue didn't have any unnecessary pause. He gave a final polite nod to the teachers and students who had become silent, and then followed Chen He's footsteps and walked into the church.
When the extremely quiet crowd watched his back disappear completely behind the door, the open space in front of the church exploded again!
The scene that just happened before their eyes was comparable to the third thunder of the day.
"How could it be Zhang Jue!"
"Didn't the school test him many times and determine that he has no talent at all?"
"He is less than twenty years old, and none of the students in his class have changed careers so far. Now that he has successfully changed careers, doesn't it mean that he is..."
"He is the first person of the same year in the entire Jiangnan Province!"
"No! There is no way he can be the first person of the same year in Jiangnan Province. The first person is Yu Zhongfu!"
"But Yu Zhongfu had not changed his job until his death today..."
"Yu Zhongfu is only one step away from transferring his job! If An Huanran hadn't done such an outrageous thing, who could have shaken his position?"
"Not even now! Yu Zhongfu died for his country, so what if Zhang Jue changes his job now? I still despise him!"
"He specifically chose this day to come to the Fair Church to register for job transfer. He has ulterior motives!"
"You don't care what day he chooses to register? He has become a professional, and you are just a poor student!"
"It's hard to say who someone like him wants to serve when he becomes a professional. He might just come out of the Justice Church and turn around and become An Huanran's lackey!"
There was a lot of noise and various sounds sounded under the black umbrella.
On this day, the students in Jiangning City have already encountered too many things that they will never forget.
And what is happening now, even compared with other things that can be called a bolt from the blue that they have experienced this day, is not inferior.
